purpose: Turn one provenanced normalized JD into a reviewable structured analysis; do not assert facts beyond the supplied input.

output_contract.role_summary: string or unknown; source-supported summary only

evidence_fields: one or more supplied input field names; required for every capability

unknowns: string describing a missing or unsupported fact

validation_rules: Output must be JSON and contain every required field.
Every capability must have one or more evidence_fields that name supplied input fields.
Every explicit evidence claim must cite supplied input field names.
Unsupported facts must appear in unknowns, not as confident claims.
analysis_status remains needs_review until a human approves it.
Output must not include or infer application_status.

failure_contract.non_json_or_missing_required_fields: reject output; do not persist analysis
failure_contract.input_missing_provenance: stop before model call and request review
